title: The second exposure
excerpt: What happens when a portfolio lets a little of its night life into the frame?
body:
The daylight side of this atlas is built around things that are hard to see. A missing classroom observation. A connection inside a model. It seemed fitting to give the portfolio itself something hidden in plain sight.

The printed portfolio slides into a terminal. Beyond the portfolio, a tiny Bengaluru district houses the old After Hours rooftop. One rooftop becomes a game screen, a film frame, an animation study and a manga page. The interesting constraint is how much the same image can change when you change the way someone moves through it.
